definitions.gloss: inseparable bond; relationship that persists despite one's wishes
definitions.explanation: A relationship or connection that continues even though the people involved may not always want it to. Often used with a tone of resignation or wry humor about a long-standing tie that simply cannot be severed.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腐|くさ}れ{縁|えん}だ。
examples.english: That guy and I go way back — we're stuck with each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腐|くさ}れ{縁|えん}で、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: We've been tied together since elementary school and still see each other often.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{元|もと}に{戻|もど}る→元に戻る：20075_motonimodoru⟧。⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{腐|くさ}れ{縁|えん}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ものだろう。
examples.english: No matter how many times we fight, we always end up back together. I suppose that's what you call an unbreakable bond.

notes: Literally 'rotten connection' — a bond so deep it cannot be cut even if it has gone bad. Despite the negative literal meaning, it is often used with affection or humor about long-standing friendships. ⟦{腐|くさ}れ→腐る：02049_kusaru⟧ is the continuative form of ⟦{腐|くさ}る→腐る：02049_kusaru⟧ (to rot), and ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ means connection or fate. Not to be confused with purely negative relationships; it often describes friendships that have endured despite ups and downs. The expression implies a certain inevitability — this is a connection that fate (or habit) has made permanent.
